sentence: This project builds and tests a way to help African American families talk about cancer genetic testing results.
This project builds a 3D brain tissue from patient stem-cell derived brain cells to model Alzheimer's disease.
This project tries to make molecular modeling and simulations more accurate, faster, and more widely available.
This project uses images of brain connectivity and machine learning to predict how patients with gliomas do after surgery.
This project studies how glucose metabolism in lung cells leads to the blood vessel changes of pulmonary hypertension caused by schistosomiasis.
This project tries to find out why women with gestational diabetes mellitus have a higher risk of coronary artery disease.
This project looks for monoclonal antibodies that bind virus surface proteins and stop virus replication in three groups of viruses.
This project builds computer methods to analyze in situ spatial transcriptomics data, including cell boundaries and cell types.
This project studies multivalent small circular RNA vaccines to see if they cause lasting immune responses against melanoma.
This project studies how T cells that fight tumors turn into T cells that help tumors in patients with colorectal cancer.
This project helps vision science researchers build imaging systems, including confocal and 2-photon microscopes.
This project tries to find out how low oxygen affects the way intestinal epithelial cells respond to enteric viruses.
This project develops MRI methods that can be used across hospitals to detect multiple system atrophy early and track how it progresses.
This project creates a gene editing method to introduce small DNA changes into the zebrafish genome.
This project shares mouse data, protocols and analytic tools so researchers can compare studies and understand how genes affect human disease.
This project combines artificial intelligence, inherited genetics and tumor molecular assays to predict the risk of breast cancer.
This project tests how neurochemical and electrophysiological regulators of sensory cortical activity relate to vivid intrusive memories of trauma.
This project uses molecular simulation and structural biology to work out how the HIV-1 Envelope protein changes as HIV-1 enters cells.
This project gets a high-definition 3D printer to make lab-on-a-chip microfluidic devices for studying blood flow and cell behavior.
This project studies the pathways that drive mitochondrial dysfunction in Down Syndrome.
